Ava (Product): Quick question from all-hands Q&A: what's the recommended process for short scheduled deploys that will spike token usage (~10 min)? Any standard ticket template? /cc @Diego

Diego (Finance): For hosted accounts open a support ticket 48h before; include expected qps, duration, and org id. We can provision a temporary quota bump or issue post-hoc credits for approved spikes. No automatic bursts today.

Riley (Eng): Note: retries + failover can multiply calls. Best practice: ramp canaries slowly and honor 429s. Also use prefix caching where possible.

Ava (Product): Can we get a pre-deploy alert at 90% quota to pause if needed?

Diego (Finance): Account-level alerts exist; we'll add a pre-deploy alert template in Console. Riley to expose route-level cost thresholds.

ticket-bot: Support ticket created: FIN-900 (deploy-burst-guidance)

Nina (SRE): Ops tip: if background migrations will call inference, run them via batch endpoints or during off-peak windows. Also include expected token estimate in the ticket.

Sam (CEO): Action: Diego to publish ticket template, Riley to add alert toggle, Product to add playbook. Reconvene if blockers.

Ava (Product): Thanks all, please tag me on the doc. :raised_hands:
